releaseNotes:
### What’s new

• Added Capture debug report in Activity Log. Choose a screenshot area, and Clickerist adds event details and recent activity. Review the report, then save it or send it through Feedback. Nothing is sent automatically.

• Debug reports now include detected ticket categories and whether the ticket options are visible, making missing-category problems easier to investigate.

• Ticketek can show known prices even when tickets are sold out or the Find public tickets prompt is still open. More sources of ticket-page price information are supported. If only an upper price is known, it is labelled Up to.

### Bug fixes

• Ticketek — F8 Instant Mode: Options sharing a name, such as Reserved Seating, could all show the same price and an incorrect Cheapest label. Each price option now stays separate, and selecting it targets that option.

• Ticketmaster — Auto Clicker: Same-name tickets at different prices could prevent Start from working even with a quantity selected. These options are now recognised separately, including when the list reloads or changes order during retries.

• Ticketek — Ticket Monitoring: Fixed blank category lists when only Best available was detected. Known categories and their separate prices remain visible for setup before the ticket controls appear.

• Fixed Waiting for ticket options hiding known availability. Categories can now show Available, Limited, Single or Sold out before opening the ticket options. A sold-out Reserved Seating price does not mark every same-name price sold out. Unconfirmed availability is labelled Availability unknown.

• Marketplace: Fixed missing categories and original prices when Ticketek uses a different category ID format or its ticket controls are hidden. Known categories such as Reserved Seating can be watched even when no resale listings currently exist. This applies across supported events, not just Iron Maiden.

• Marketplace: When several original prices share a category name, Clickerist shows Original price varies by ticket instead of choosing an arbitrary price or calculating a misleading profit.

• Marketplace: Rescanning can add missing categories to a partial catalogue while preserving working complete catalogues, saved selections, price limits and refresh settings.

• Added clearer guidance when ticket options cannot be confirmed. Clickerist stops instead of guessing, and hidden ticket controls are not clicked automatically.

After updating: Reload Clickerist and refresh your ticket pages. For Marketplace, refresh the matching Ticketek performance, then press Rescan categories. Older same-name selections may need the exact price option reselected. Allow screenshot access if asked, and review screenshots for personal information before sending. Prices and availability depend on readable matching Ticketek data and do not guarantee a reservation.
